desc: A large wolf-shaped Backrooms entity of black shadow wearing a torn wallpaper cape and gold armor trim, crown of fluorescent tubes, pale glowing eyes. Chibi game pet sprite in exactly the same art style, palette, rendering and shading as the reference otter, 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, standing full body filling the frame, dark navy 1px outline, muted colors, no ground shadow, no glow.
